test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 9 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

All the young boys and girls / in the family / will try his luck / in the card games tonight.

options.text: All the young boys and girls

solution:
The correct answer is** "will try his luck"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 Here let's see the whole sentence:

 
• All the young boys and girls in the family** will try his luck** in the card games tonight.​
 
• It should be** "their"** instead of** "his"**
 
• **Their** is used instead of his or her, ‘his’ for more than one subject.

**Correct sentence: **All the young boys and girls in the family will try their luck in the card games tonight.
